content: Next.js 16 sitemap.ts: default export returns MetadataRoute.Sitemap array of {url, lastModified, changeFrequency, priority, alternates:{languages:{locale:url}}}. Localized sitemap entries emit xhtml:link rel=alternate hreflang tags inside sitemap.xml directly (per official docs example). generateSitemaps() only needed to SPLIT into multiple sitemap files at 50,000-URL-per-file Google limit (served at /.../sitemap/[id]); for ~4 locales x few dozen pages/products/articles a single sitemap.ts is sufficient, no index needed.
